name: AI Builder – Generate pages, blocks, images & translate with AI
author: Enki

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress workflow with the ultimate AI Copilot. AI Builder is not just another template shuffler. It is a native AI Page Builder that generates 100% custom Gutenberg pages, blocks, and content tailored to your specific prompts.

Whether you need a high-converting landing page, a complex “Features” section, or a full blog post with images, AI Builder creates it in seconds—right inside the editor.

🚀 Start for FREE: Get 100 credits immediately upon signup (No credit card required).

🔍 Why Choose AI Builder?

Most AI tools force you to use their proprietary builders. AI Builder works natively with Gutenberg. This means zero bloat, perfect performance, and you own the code forever.

What you can achieve in minutes:

  • ⚡ Instant Page Building: Generate complete Homepages, About Us, or Pricing pages from a simple description.
  • 🎨 Custom Design & CSS: The AI doesn’t just insert text; it styles your blocks with custom CSS to match your brand identity.
  • 🧩 Smart Block Creation: Need a specific “Pros & Cons” table or a “Team Member” slider? Just ask, and the AI builds the block structure for you.
  • ✍️ Context-Aware Copywriting: Write SEO-optimized headings, paragraphs, and CTAs that actually sound like your brand.
  • 🖼️ Integrated AI Images: Generate royalty-free, unique images directly inside your image blocks. No more searching for stock photos.
  • 📱 Performance First: All generated images are automatically compressed for the web.
  • 🌍 Go Global Instantly: Translate entire pages, headers, and footers in one click. The AI handles the content translation and automatically links pages together with a built-in language switcher.
  • 🤖 Site Management Made Simple: Control your entire WordPress site with natural language commands. No more navigating through complex menus—just ask Site Copilot what you need.

“Perfect for freelancers, agencies, and site owners who want to scaffold websites in hours, not days.”

Key Features

  • 🧠 AI Page Generator – Turn a single sentence into a fully designed landing page (Header, Content, Footer).
  • 📦 Gutenberg Native – Creates standard blocks that are lightweight and fully editable.
  • 🎨 Smart Styling System – Generates custom CSS for every element based on your prompt.
  • 🖼️ Text-to-Image Engine – Generate and insert relevant images without leaving WordPress.
  • ✍️ Content Copilot – Expand, rewrite, or translate text directly within any paragraph block.
  • ⚙️ Brand Awareness – Define your site colors and business info in settings; the AI applies them to every generation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Page Generator – Create up to 10 pages simultaneously to build a full site structure in one click.
  • 🌐 AI Translation Engine – Clone and translate full pages with context-aware AI. Automatically adds a frontend language switcher and manages navigation routing between languages.
  • 🤖 Site Copilot – Manage your WordPress site using natural language. Ask Site Copilot to list posts, update pages, moderate comments, or adjust settings — no code or complex interfaces. An AI assistant that executes your commands in real time with granular security controls.
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Integration – Fully compatible with WooCommerce. The AI automatically detects WooCommerce and includes product blocks when creating e-commerce pages. Use Site Copilot to create products and manage WooCommerce settings via chat commands.

Credits

Developed by enkicorbin

Support

For support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit our website: https://website-ai-builder.com
Thank you for choosing WordPress AI Builder!
sections.installation:
1. Install AI Builder via the WordPress.org plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Create an account
  4. Start using the AI tools in your Gutenberg editor
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free to try?

Yes! You get 100 free credits immediately upon signup to test all features (page generation, text, images). No credit card or OpenAI API key is required.

What happens to my content if I cancel my subscription?

You keep 100% of your content. Unlike other builders, AI Builder generates standard WordPress Gutenberg blocks and CSS that are saved directly to your database. If you cancel your subscription, your pages will look exactly the same and remain fully editable.

Do I need my own OpenAI API Key?

No. We handle all the AI processing on our secure servers. You don’t need to pay for ChatGPT or OpenAI separately; everything is included in your credits.

Does it work with my Theme (Astra, Kadence, OceanWP, etc.)?

Yes. AI Builder generates native blocks that inherit your theme’s global settings (fonts, widths, etc.). It is designed to work seamlessly with any well-coded WordPress theme.

Can I edit the content after it’s generated?

Absolutely. The AI creates standard blocks (Headings, Paragraphs, Images, Columns). You can click and edit them just like any other content in WordPress.

Are the generated images optimized for the web?

Yes. Images generated by the AI are automatically compressed and converted to web-friendly formats to ensure your site loads fast, without sacrificing quality.

Can I use this with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

AI Builder is designed for the native Gutenberg Editor to ensure maximum performance and PageSpeed scores. However, you can use it alongside other builders if you use Gutenberg for your blog posts or specific landing pages.

How do the credits work?

Each action (generating a page, a block, or an image) costs a certain amount of credits. You can view your balance directly in the plugin interface. We offer flexible subscriptions and one-time credit packs if you need more.

Can I make my website multilingual with AI Builder?

Yes. You can translate any page, header, or footer into another language with a single click. The AI doesn’t just translate word-for-word; it adapts the context. The plugin automatically adds a language switcher to your site and handles the routing, so users are seamlessly redirected to the correct page in their language.

Do I need a separate plugin like WPML or Polylang?

For most standard websites, no. AI Builder’s built-in translation features handle page duplication, content translation, and menu linking automatically. It’s a lightweight alternative designed to get your multilingual site running in minutes without complex configuration.

Is AI Builder compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! AI Builder is fully compatible with WooCommerce. When WooCommerce is installed, the AI automatically detects it and will include WooCommerce-specific blocks (product cards, add to cart buttons, product galleries, etc.) when you ask it to create a product page or any e-commerce related content. Additionally, if you activate the appropriate WooCommerce REST API routes in Site Copilot’s security settings, you can use natural language commands to create products, manage inventory, configure shipping settings, and perform other WooCommerce operations directly through the chat interface.
